title: Shortcuts
description: Every shortcut from Apple's Shortcuts app, grouped by folder. Run one with Enter, with the clipboard or typed text as its input, and see the result when it ends.

store.tagline: Run any Apple Shortcut by name, folders as sections
features: Every shortcut findable by name from the root, grouped by its folder
`enter` runs it and shows Done or its output when it finishes, however long it takes
`cmd+enter` runs it on the clipboard text, `cmd+t` on text you type in the bar
`cmd+o` opens it in Shortcuts for editing
A global hotkey for any shortcut, set by its name in your config
